title: Nvidia Senior Director Madison Huang, daughter of Jensen, cancels a high-profile Seoul appearance citing a "family matter", throwing the event into disarray (Yoolim Lee/Bloomberg)
summary: Yoolim Lee / Bloomberg: Nvidia Senior Director Madison Huang, daughter of Jensen, cancels a high-profile Seoul appearance citing a “family matter”, throwing the event into disarray — Nvidia Corp. co-founder Jensen Huang's daughter planned to showcase deepening ties with two of South Korea's most important AI players Monday.
